text: Then we heard a horrible cry. <break time="0.8s" /> From the next room. <break time="0.8s" /> A cry of pain, fear, and anger. <break time="0.8s" /> All mixed together. <break time="0.8s" /> We ran into the doctors room. <break time="0.8s" /> And found Doctor Roylott. <break time="0.8s" /> Sitting in a chair. <break time="0.8s" /> With a strange yellow band. <break time="0.8s" /> Around his head. <break time="0.8s" /> The band, The speckled band. <break time="0.8s" /> Whispered Holmes. <break time="0.8s" /> For it was a swamp adder. <break time="0.8s" /> The deadliest snake in India. <break time="0.8s" /> The snake had bitten the doctor. <break time="0.8s" /> And killed him in seconds. <break time="0.8s" /> And it was his own evil plan. <break time="0.8s" /> That had ended his life. <break time="0.8s" /> Holmes carefully caught the snake. <break time="0.8s" /> With the dog whip. <break time="0.8s" /> Threw it into the iron safe. <break time="0.8s" /> And closed the heavy door. <break time="0.8s" /> Later Holmes explained. <break time="0.8s" /> That the word band. <break time="0.8s" /> Had first made him think of the gypsies. <break time="0.8s" /> Which was a mistake. <break time="0.8s" /> The doctor sent the snake. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the ventilator. <break time="0.8s" /> And down the rope to the bed. <break time="0.8s" /> And he called it back. <break time="0.8s" /> With a whistle. <break time="0.8s" /> If Miss Stoner had not come to us. <break time="0.8s" /> She would have died. <break time="0.8s" /> In exactly the same way. <break time="0.8s" /> As her sister. <break time="0.8s" /> When I hit the snake with my cane. <break time="0.8s" /> It turned back. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the ventilator. <break time="0.8s" /> And attacked its own master instead. <break time="0.8s" /> In this way. <break time="0.8s" /> I am partly responsible. <break time="0.8s" /> For his death. <break time="0.8s" /> But I cannot say. <break time="0.8s" /> That it will trouble my conscience. <break time="0.8s" /> Very much.
